track: C — real CEEW telemetry with injected labels
honesty: REAL telemetry (CEEW Mathura/Bareilly, CC0) with SYNTHETIC injected labels (Zidi et al. 2023 + our DT-hook extension). NOT real theft labels. Virtual DTs, star topology, single-phase, no weather. No field-performance claim.

dt_hook.note: DT-hook is our extension beyond Zidi et al.

periodicity.note: WoW-PCC over full history, clean vs injected. Zheng et al. thresholds (normal > 0.8, thieves < 0.7) quoted for reference; transfer to this cohort is an empirical question (clean meters already sit far below 0.8). WoW-PCC is invariant to within-day reversal (T6) by construction: the same permutation applies to both correlated weeks.
